kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: We have a limited window to strengthen cyber defenses, and together with organizations including @AnthropicAI, @awscloud, @Google, @Microsoft, and @Oracle, we're calling for a global effort to give defenders the tools, resources, and support to protect the infrastructure we all
kept_items.selection_reason: OpenAI special-account self-contained post; multi-lab cyber-defense coalition.

kept_items.author: sama
kept_items.text: this is a critically important moment for cyber defense with AI; there is not much time to act. we are happy if you want to work with us or any of our competitors or partners, but please take this moment seriously. only an urgent and intense collective response will work.
kept_items.selection_reason: sama special-account self-contained post accompanying the coalition call.

kept_items.author: AnthropicAI
kept_items.text: Today, we're kicking off the first phase of the research preview for Model Hardware Standard (MHS): a new standard for AI agents to safely operate physical equipment in scientific research and advanced manufacturing.
kept_items.selection_reason: AnthropicAI special-account self-contained root tweet; Model Hardware Standard research preview.

kept_items.author: ClementDelangue
kept_items.text: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT FROM HUGGING FACE TODAY: We're unveiling Microduck. It's a tiny $399 open-source robot you can teach new tricks with reinforcement learning. It can walk, pick things up, get back up when it falls, and even roller-skate.
kept_items.selection_reason: Hugging Face CEO unveils $399 open-source RL robot.

kept_items.author: TIME
kept_items.text: TIME's new cover: Announcing the 2026 TIME100 AI, the world's most influential people in artificial intelligence
kept_items.selection_reason: TIME100 AI 2026 list release, high engagement.

kept_items.author: ns123abc
kept_items.text: BREAKING: ANTHROPIC WINS. PENTAGON BLACKLIST RULED UNCONSTITUTIONAL. Federal judge in California just ruled: Pentagon's effort to blacklist Anthropic violated the First Amendment, violated Due Process Clause of the Fifth Amendment, Supply chain risk designation: VACATED
kept_items.selection_reason: Court ruling vacating Pentagon blacklist of Anthropic.

kept_items.author: kwindla
kept_items.text: Introducing PhoneLLM, an open model for voice agents. GPT 5.6 Terra performance on typical voice agent tasks at 1/3 the latency and 1/18 the cost. For voice agents, we need models that are both very low latency and very good at tool calling and instruction following.
kept_items.selection_reason: Open model release for low-latency voice agents.

kept_items.author: HedgieMarkets
kept_items.text: Thomson Reuters just built its own AI model for about $40 million over two years. The final training run cost $450,000. They started with Qwen, an open-source model from China's Alibaba, and trained it on their own legal and news content from Westlaw, Practical Law
kept_items.selection_reason: Enterprise trains own model on Qwen for $40M; open-weight cost story.

kept_items.author: MTSlive
kept_items.text: SITUATION DETECTED: Sam Altman says that OpenAI plans to build its own humanoid robots, and that their first uses may be to build more robots and then to construct future data centers, per Alex Heath.
kept_items.selection_reason: Altman on OpenAI building humanoid robots.

kept_items.author: IlirAliu_
kept_items.text: The University of Michigan put their entire robotics degree on GitHub. Not one course. The whole curriculum. ROB 101, ROB 311, ROB 501, ROB 530.
kept_items.selection_reason: University of Michigan opens robotics curriculum on GitHub.

kept_items.author: LigengZhu
kept_items.text: Introducing GLM-5.3-Flash. Leading capabilities at a highly competitive price. Natively multimodal with a 1M-token context window. A 320B-A18B model released under the MIT License. Previously previewed as Ox Alpha, running entirely on Chinese AI chips.
kept_items.selection_reason: MIT-licensed 320B multimodal model on Chinese chips.

kept_items.author: firesidealpha
kept_items.text: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says he has no interest in destroying the SaaS companies his models are supposedly wiping out. We're not interested in destroying anyone. We think of this as a very positive sum thing.
kept_items.selection_reason: Amodei on not destroying SaaS companies.
